description: Pure C# service that recognises Notion-style markdown shortcut patterns typed at the beginning of a block line. Call Detect after the user presses Space or Enter, passing the full plain-text content of the current block including the trigger character. Matching is prefix-based, so the text after the trigger is returned in TextAfterTrigger. Recognised prefixes, most specific first: "### ", "## ", "# ", "- [x] ", "- [ ] ", "[x] ", "[ ] ", "[] ", "* ", "- ", "> ", plus any digits followed by ". " for a numbered list. The exact tokens "```" and "---" (Enter) become a Code block and a Divider. FromJsShortcutKey and IsCheckedTodo bridge the shortcut keys emitted by notion-editor.js to the C# type system.

members.name: Detect
members.description: Analyses lineText and returns the conversion suggestion, or null when no known shortcut is recognised.

members.name: FromJsShortcutKey
members.description: Converts the shortcut string emitted by notion-editor.js (e.g. "heading1", "bullet") into the corresponding BlockType, or null when the string is unrecognised. This bridges the existing JS-side detection with the C# type system.

members.name: IsCheckedTodo
members.description: Returns true if jsShortcutKey represents a checked todo shortcut ("todo_checked" / "[x] " pattern).
